definitions.explanation: A gesture of respect made by bending the body.

notes:
{礼|れい} has three main meanings: a physical bow, gratitude/thanks, and manners/etiquette. It is a central concept in Japanese culture, reflecting the importance of respect and proper conduct.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {礼|れい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to bow
- お{礼|れい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to express thanks
- {礼|れい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尽|つ}くす→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧: to show the utmost courtesy
- {礼|れい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧: to lack manners
- お{礼|れい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: as thanks, in return

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{礼儀|れいぎ}→礼儀：03780_reigi⟧: manners, courtesy
- ⟦{失礼|しつれい}→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧: rudeness; excuse me
- ⟦{敬礼|けいれい}→敬礼：19877_keirei⟧: salute
- ⟦{無礼|ぶれい}→無礼：15041_burei⟧: rudeness, disrespect
- ⟦{礼状|れいじょう}→礼状：15365_reijou⟧: thank-you letter

USAGE:
The prefix お is often added (お{礼|れい}) when referring to gratitude, making it more polite. {礼|れい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ specifically means to bow physically, while お{礼|れい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ means to express verbal thanks.
